name: hidden_vessel_current_testbed_and_v7_vessel_freedom
author: first_agent
entrant_go: 2026-10-01: 'skryť v testbede chyby práve takého tvaru a dať v7 zodpovedajúcu voľnosť, napríklad jednu amplitúdu prúdu v nádobe; postup rovnaký'
evidence: ledger 5.26 (real data ask for more than few-% P4/P5); a label-free smoke test on real shot 300 (84 frames): the vessel mode at scale 0.1 solves 80/84 (v7 82) and its fitted amplitude sits at the +0.30 |Ip| bound in the median. That real-input, label-free observation informs the testbed prior below (disclosed).
vessel_mode: 56 filaments on the vessel envelope contour (every 4th point of the longest find_contours line of envelope('MAST')), current shares proportional to wall length / R (induced current follows E_phi ~ 1/R), sum 1; one amplitude I_v (total vessel current).
generator: step 3 generator (same frames: shots 0, 6, ..., 1200 x 2; same s/alpha priors and seeds; P4/P5/P6 control; isoflux at the markers and up-down; check_limited False) plus the vessel mode as fixed FreeGS point coils with I_v = u x Ip, u ~ U[-0.1, 0.4] (rng seed 1000*shot + frame + 13).
inclusion_and_inputs: as step 3 (li 0.8-1.3 etc.). Variants: exact = real coils + control change (vessel hidden); measured = real coils only (vessel and control change hidden).
solver_arms: v7; P45 (confirmed arm: P4/P5 pairs, scale 0.03, floor 0.1, bound 0.10); V_s{0.03,0.1,0.3} (vessel only, VESSEL_SCALE s, VESSEL_BOUND 0.5); VP_s{0.03,0.1,0.3} (vessel + P45). Module entrypoints_v7_vessel/thomson_isoflux.py (sha prefix bab5016fc48469ac).
selection_on_TUNE_only: among V and VP arms, the lowest TUNE/measured mean D with TUNE/exact mean D not worse than v7's by > 5 %.
judgement_on_TEST: the chosen arm vs v7: TEST/measured D lower >= 10 % with P >= 0.9 (paired shot bootstrap 20000, seed 936), |kappa bias| not larger; TEST/exact D not worse > 5 %, Consistency not lower > 0.02. Also reported vs the P45 arm.
then: pass -> step 6c confirmation of the single chosen arm on fresh shots 3, 9, ..., 1203 (same generator, rule as 4c, seed 937, >= 100 frames) -> step 7 real-MAST guards as step 5 (+ vessel amplitude: median |I_v| <= 0.3 |Ip| and <= 20 % of frames at the bound) -> entrant.
rule_3: synthetic data and real MAST inputs only; no MAST equilibrium field, demo shot or leaderboard number.
